title: Steward plant registry, format 1
description: Sites of an enterprise with their ISA-95 (IEC 62264) hierarchy – area, work center, work unit –, the buildings (IEC 81346 location aspect) and the assets in them; device profiles with their interfaces and data points (OPC UA IEC 62541, Modbus, IEC 61131-3, UCUM), KPI definitions (ISO 22400-2) and the assignments of assets. See docs/PLANT.md.
